name: Consensus
summary: External research capability candidate for source-backed evidence synthesis when a ticket explicitly requires research support.

source.notes: Registered as a candidate evidence capability. This entry makes no claim about tool quality or coverage.

useWhen: A research or validation ticket asks for source-backed synthesis and external research capability use is approved.
Scientific or market-evidence claims need citations and contradiction checks.
doNotUseWhen: The result would be treated as customer validation, willingness to pay, legal conclusion, medical conclusion, or compliance proof.
routing.fallback: Use repository research protocol and cite primary sources directly.

inputs.name: researchQuestion
inputs.description: Narrow research question tied to a validation or research ticket.

outputs.name: evidenceSynthesis
outputs.description: Cited findings, confidence, contradictions, and limits.

schemas.notes: Future adapter work may define normalized research result schemas.

forbiddenOperations: Make sensitive conclusions without specialist review

cost.costDriver: External service availability, account limits, or usage policy.

risks.description: External research can be over-promoted into product proof.
risks.mitigation: Keep research as evidence input and preserve source citations, confidence, and limits.

governance.dataBoundary: Use public or approved research questions only; do not send secrets, private founder context, or customer data.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Do not convert research output into customer evidence, market proof, legal claims, compliance claims, or medical/financial advice.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record source links, confidence, contradictions, and external capability use in the artifact or handoff.
governance.updatePolicy: Update this entry after a dedicated evaluation reviews actual tool behavior.

review.reviewNotes: Proposed entry; not approved for autonomous use.

examples.scenario: A validation ticket asks for evidence about a technical or scientific assumption.
examples.expectedUse: Use Consensus only if approved, then cite sources and call out uncertainty.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not use Consensus output as proof of market demand or customer willingness to pay.
